newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGS-Thomson first quarter result falls.
newsitem.headline: SGS-Thomson first quarter result falls.

text.p: SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV, the Franco-Italian semiconductor producer reported a fall in first quarter earnings Monday due to lower prices but it said it expects improvements in the next quarter.

SGS-Thomson, listed on Paris and New York stock exchanges, reported a drop in net income to $90.50 million from $175 million on lower sales of $944.90 million against $1.03 billion in the first quarter of 1996. The company pays no dividend.
"As expected, first quarter revenues were negatively impacted by market pricing conditions," President Pasquale Pistorio said in a statement.
"Also, the combination of a stronger dollar and lower demand for products destined for digital consumer applications reduced first quarter demand," he said.
Pistorio addded that orders were up last month and that sales in the second quarter were expected to be around $1 billion dollars.
